newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - AWB MD Lawrenson to leave when contract ends.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - AWB MD Lawrenson to leave when contract ends.

text.p: The managing director of the Australian Wheat Board (AWB), John Lawrenson, said he will step down when his contract expires next year.
It was expected to take four to six months to recruit a suitable chief executive officer and he would leave after a short hand-over period, he said in a statement.

"It's the right time to move on. All the signs suggest that we will see a new corporate entity established next year and then is a good time for a new chief executive to assume the responsibility of positioning that company in the market place," he said.
The AWB now had a very sharp commercial focus, he said.
Growers wanted first to keep the single desk export marketing of wheat and then to have control of the marketer and their own destiny, he said.
Lawrenson became the AWB's first managing director almost seven years ago. Previously, its chief executive was styled the general manager.
